summary: AvalonBay Communities, Inc. (AvalonBay) filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Equity Residential and its subsidiaries. The merger of equals will combine the two REITs via an all-stock transaction. AvalonBay will contribute assets for OP Units, then merge with Merger Sub. Both boards unanimously approved and recommend the transaction. No per-share price, premium, or dollar values are disclosed in the filing. The combined company will adopt a new name. The transaction is subject to stockholder votes and regulatory approvals. The risk-arb angle centers on stock-election ratios and closing timeline.
